recap.text: Donut receives a black, magical collar for Mongo from the gold pet box, one that places his orange dot on the map wherever he is. Mongo screams and tries to rip it off. After a few admonishments from Donut, he relents and stops scratching at it.

Katia and Donut come back from the Desperado Club, where they spent the whole two hours of the storm, Katia with a feather boa round her neck. Mongo is loose too, with a boa of his own dangling from his collar, and he keeps snapping at it while feathers fly everywhere. Donut and Katia went into the Penis Parade together.
